pages.learnerAction: Listen to how the eight-question pool for “Something you've recently got into” will be used, then begin the conversation.
pages.tutorAction: React or share briefly, follow interesting details, skip prompts freely, and reserve two to three minutes for feedback.

pages.learningTarget: Frame “Something you've recently got into” as reciprocal conversation rather than eight questions to complete in order.

pages.failureDiagnosis: No language failure is tested; a rigid interview-like flow would show that the operating note was not followed.
pages.nonTargetSupport: The Japanese line explicitly says not every question is required and that interesting answer details should guide the talk.

pages.choiceQuality: No choices or distractors appear; this is a concise operating transition.
